title: Job Search Goals
description:
A good job search goals is a goal you can control. Unfortunately you just can't control when you get an interview or an offer but you CAN control how often you apply to jobs, update your resume, and other *input* variables. As we approach the new year set your goals on things you can control so you always know you've met the marks you set. #jobsearch #jobseeker #jobseekers #jobsearchtips #careergoals
